newsitem.title: UK: Royal & Sun gains on NatWest recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun gains on NatWest recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc rose after NatWest Securities reiterated its "buy" stance on the sector, picking out Royal and Guardian Royal Exchange Plc as favoured stocks.
Royal put on 10p to 481-1/2p and Guardian eased 1-1/2p to 293p in a lower overall market. General Accident Plc rose 15p to 921-1/2p and Commercial Union Plc 8p to 688-1/2p.
"Royal and Guardian are our preferred stocks in the sector buy buyers have obviously voted towards Royal," said NatWest analyst Paul Goodhind.
Goodhind said recent underperformance in the sector had led to a de-rating which he considered unjustified and he took the view that upcoming results in about a fortnight's time would be robust.
